observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries high-arousal urgency to purge information, a directive performed with forceful erasure energy rather than calm request.
Imperative 'Remove all knowledge' escalates the erasure demand with totalizing 'all,' registering sustained urgency-as-directive rather than settled instruction.
Flat declarative correcting a record with resigned finality — low arousal, negative valence of a correction that closes down rather than energizes.
